items.title: cd Shortcuts
items.text: Shell aliases for jumping to frequently used directories. Keeps common cd targets short and consistent across sessions.

items.title: Aliases
items.text:
• back: Change to the parent directory.
  • repo: Change to ~/Documents/github_repositories.
  • docs: Change to ~/Documents.
  • downloads: Change to ~/Downloads.
  • dl: Alias for downloads.
  • home: Change to ~.
  • temp: Change to ~/Documents/Temporary.
  • vault: Change to ~/Documents/grymms_grimoires.
